verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an enterprise VPC deployment option where data/storage stay in the customer's VPC, but state that processing itself still runs on Reducto's own GPU infrastructure — not a fully self-hosted/air-gapped model. No independent or hands-on corroboration of this deployment mode exists in the evidence pack. missing for 10: fully self-hosted (no external processing) option, architecture/network isolation details, and independent verification of the VPC deployment claim.
